name: agentic-runtime
description: Durable multi-session work: goals, plans, work items, checkpoints, resumability, execution reports and user memory in a plain-markdown workspace. Optional — skip it if your orchestrator already provides durable work.

interface.shortDescription: Outbound work that survives a restart
interface.longDescription: Gives an agent a plain-markdown workspace for work that outlives one session: goals broken into plans and work items, checkpoints it can resume from, reports of what a run actually did, and durable notes about the user. Optional — skip it if your orchestrator already provides durable work.
defaultPrompt: Turn this goal into a plan I can resume tomorrow
Where did we leave off on the Q3 outbound push?
Report on what this run actually changed
